label: TP
reason: Multiple genuine vulnerabilities identified: (1) java/stack-trace-exposure alerts (2-7) expose full stack traces to HTTP response via e.printStackTrace(response.getWriter()) in catch blocks - sensitive system info leaked to clients; (2) java/weak-cryptographic-algorithm alerts (8-9) use DES which has only 56-bit key strength, vulnerable to brute force; (3) java/xss alert (1) has proper ESAPI.encodeForHTML() mitigation applied before HTML output, making it effectively mitigated but included in multi-vuln finding. At least one alert (stack-trace-exposure) is definitively exploitable.

evidence.note: Stack trace exposure via e.printStackTrace(response.getWriter()) in multiple catch blocks exposes sensitive error information to clients
Weak cryptographic algorithm usage - DES with 56-bit key length is cryptographically broken
